payload.title: the close report has no sender and no restatement
payload.body: Beside the assay of closed-plan-route of notebook-gaps at 03bdff17 (not-achieved). The architect role contract now reads the planner's report that a plan has closed and routes the closed plan to the integrator, but two neighbouring surfaces still leave that report out. The planner role contract (packages/canon/src/dimensions/role/planner.ts) returns only a plan name and ready unit names, so nothing states that the planner sends the close report the architect now reads. The architect role cell's archetype (packages/canon/src/roles/architect.ts) enumerates the architect's routes and lists every unit route but not the closed plan to the integrator. The first bears on planner role, not architect role; the second is a restatement of architect role that is now narrower than its contract.
